assertions.name: preflight.anonymous.create.401
assertions.why: 创建端点受统一安全链保护；匿名可写意味着整个工单入口失守

assertions.name: login.employee.200
assertions.why: 创建与详情断言全部由这个身份执行；登录失败说明演示账号口令与 .env/默认值不一致

assertions.name: login.it.200
assertions.why: 重复关闭回归需要 IT 领取并关闭；登录失败则该组断言无法进行

assertions.name: categories.options.nonEmpty
assertions.why: 接口建单必须带 categoryId；没有启用分类就没法造出真实的载体工单

assertions.name: preflight.db.available
assertions.expected: 1（.env 加载且 docker exec 可查库）
assertions.why: 指纹、关联行直查与清理都依赖数据库直连；不可用时后面所有直查断言都失去意义

assertions.name: setup.temp.viewer.created
assertions.expected: 临时用户 + 只含 TICKET_VIEW_OWN 的角色建好
assertions.actual: username=rl-acc-20261012-111017-viewer roleCode=RL_ACC_20261012_111017-VIEWER userId=79 roleId=127 exitCode=0 stderr=[]
assertions.why: 临时主体是"他人工单不可见"与 403 两格的唯一装置；建不出来这两格无法进行

assertions.name: setup.foreignTicket.created
assertions.expected: 他人待受理工单夹具插入成功
assertions.why: 它专供"原工单对提交人不可见 → 400"这一格；没有它，该格只能跳过

assertions.name: a1.create.original.201
assertions.why: 原工单是后续全部断言的地基；这一步失败后面没有可引用的对象

assertions.name: a1.detail.original.200
assertions.why: 详情是关联摘要的唯一出口；这一步同时证明目标后端包含工单关联代码

assertions.name: a1.detail.relations.fieldPresent
assertions.actual: fieldPresent=True count=0；若字段不存在说明目标后端不含 2026-10-12 的关联代码
assertions.why: relations 是本次新增的契约字段；用"字段存在且为空"同时证明端点存活与"无关联返回空数组"

assertions.name: a1.detail.relations.empty
assertions.why: 没有关联的工单必须返回空数组而不是省略字段，界面才能统一按列表渲染

assertions.name: a1.db.original.hasNoRelation
assertions.why: 无引用创建不得写关联（关联只在带 sourceTicketNo 的创建里产生）

assertions.name: a2.create.followUp.201
assertions.why: 后续工单创建成功是关联写入的前提；400 说明可见性校验把原工单误判为不可见

assertions.name: a2.db.followUp.relationWritten
assertions.expected: 1 行：source=后续工单 target=原工单 type=FOLLOW_UP created_by=提交人
assertions.why: 方向约定（source = 新工单、target = 原工单）是唯一键与四格标签的共同前提

assertions.name: a2.db.relation.directionAndType
assertions.why: 写入行必须与"新工单指向原工单"的方向逐字一致，created_by 记提交人

assertions.name: a2.db.relation.onePerSource
assertions.why: 唯一键 (source, relation_type) 保证一张单只有一条后续指向

assertions.name: a2.detail.followUp.oneRelation
assertions.why: 新单视角应恰有一条出向关联

assertions.name: a2.detail.followUp.outgoingShape
assertions.expected: FOLLOW_UP + OUTGOING + FD-20261012-001 + 原工单标题 + PENDING
assertions.actual: type=FOLLOW_UP direction=OUTGOING ticketNo=FD-20261012-001 status=PENDING title=RL-ACC-20261012-111017-原工单
assertions.why: 新单视角是"本单是 source"→ OUTGOING；摘要的四个字段是前端四格标签之外的全部信息

assertions.name: a2.detail.original.incomingShape
assertions.why: 同一行数据在原工单视角必须翻转为 INCOMING——方向是"相对当前工单"算的，不是写死的

assertions.name: a3.create.unknownSource.400
assertions.why: 不存在的编号必须被校验挡住；201 说明后端忽略了 sourceTicketNo（旧构建或字段没接上）

assertions.name: a3.create.invisibleSource.400
assertions.why: 他人的工单对员工不可见；必须与"不存在"同一种 400，不回显他人工单是否存在

assertions.name: a3.db.noTicketFromRejectedCreates
assertions.why: 被拒绝的创建不落工单——校验先于编号分配与插入

assertions.name: a3.db.noRelationFromRejectedCreates
assertions.expected: 1（只算 a2 写入的那一条）
assertions.why: 两条被拒绝的创建都不能写关联；计数为 1 说明只有 a2 的合法引用落了库

assertions.name: a4.replay.sameTicketNo
assertions.expected: 两次都是 201 且编号相同
assertions.why: 重放必须返回首次创建结果；编号不同意味着同一次提交建出了两张工单

assertions.name: a4.db.replay.singleRelation
assertions.why: 重放不再写第二条 FOLLOW_UP（唯一键与幂等路径双重保护）

assertions.name: a4.db.replay.singleTicket
assertions.why: 同一提交键在库里只能有一行

assertions.name: a5.create.duplicate.201
assertions.why: 重复关闭回归的载体；失败则该组无法进行

assertions.name: a5.claim.200
assertions.why: 关闭只允许「处理中」的当前负责人；领取失败则关闭无法进行

assertions.name: a5.close.duplicate.200
assertions.actual: status=200 code=OK body=[{"code":"OK","message":"操作成功","data":{"ticketNo":"FD-20261012-004","status":"CLOSED","assignee":{"id":2,"displayName":"IT 支持人员"},"version":2,"actionTime":"2026-10-12T03:10:27.897Z"}}]
assertions.why: 既有 DUPLICATE 写入路径必须不受本次改动影响（回归）

assertions.name: a5.db.duplicate.relationWritten
assertions.why: 重复关闭的既有方向（source=被关闭的本单）必须保持不变

assertions.name: a5.db.duplicate.closeFields
assertions.why: 关闭字段与状态不因本次改动漂移

assertions.name: a5.detail.relations.count
assertions.expected: 3 条（a2/a4 两条 FOLLOW_UP + a5 一条 DUPLICATE）
assertions.why: 两类关联共存说明唯一键 (source, relation_type) 按预期工作，不是"一张单只能有一条关联"

assertions.name: a5.detail.relations.fixedOrder
assertions.why: 排序是契约的一部分：后续关联在前、重复关联在后，界面分组才不会随数据变化

assertions.name: a5.detail.relations.allIncoming
assertions.why: 原工单是三组关系的 target，方向必须全部翻转

assertions.name: a6.login.tempViewer.200
assertions.why: 403 闸门需要真实登录的"低权限账号"；登录失败则该格无法进行

assertions.name: a6.create.byTempViewer.403
assertions.why: 方法级授权先于请求体语义；没有创建权限的账号连"原工单是否可见"都不该被判断

assertions.name: a6.db.noTicketFromForbiddenCreate
assertions.why: 被 403 的创建不落任何数据

assertions.name: a6.detail.tempOwnTicket.200
assertions.expected: 200（夹具工单对它的提交人可见）
assertions.why: 夹具工单真实存在且可被它自己的提交人看到，因此员工引用它得到 400 是"不可见"而不是"不存在"

assertions.name: a6.detail.anonymous.401
assertions.why: 详情是工单正文的出口；匿名可读意味着数据泄露

assertions.name: a7.cleanup.sqlApplied
assertions.why: 本脚本创建的行必须由自己删干净（指纹对照的前提）

assertions.name: a7.cleanup.noLeftoverTickets
assertions.why: 自建工单与夹具工单都必须删除

assertions.name: a7.cleanup.noLeftoverPrincipals
assertions.why: 临时用户与临时角色都必须删除（含它们的用户角色与角色权限）

assertions.name: a7.fingerprint.unchanged
assertions.expected: 运行前与清理后逐项相同（10 项计数 + 逐行指纹）
assertions.why: 本脚本只允许动自己创建的行；指纹不同意味着动了运行前就存在的行

SELECT status, IFNULL(close_method,'NULL'), IFNULL(close_reason,'NULL') FROM ticket WHERE id = 305;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE title LIKE 'RL-ACC-20261012-111017-无权限创建%';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE title LIKE 'RL-ACC-20261012-111017-%' OR ticket_no = 'RL-FIXTURE-20261012-111017';
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_user WHERE username = 'rl-acc-20261012-111017-viewer') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_role WHERE code = 'RL_ACC_20261012_111017-VIEWER');

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_record), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_participant), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_relation), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_user), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_user_role), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_role), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_role_permission), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iam_permission), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_category);
SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(ticket_no ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ','),'-') FROM ticket;

SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ticket_no,'|',status,'|',version,'|',record_seq,'|',IFNULL(assignee_id,-1),'|',IF(ended_at IS NULL,'NULL','SET'),'|',IFNULL(close_method,'NULL'),'|',IFNULL(close_reason,'NULL'),'|',DATE_FORMAT(updated_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f')) ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' ;; '),'-') FROM ticket;

SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(id,'|',ticket_id,'|',sequence_no,'|',record_type,'|',actor_type,'|',IFNULL(actor_user_id,-1),'|',DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f')) ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' ;; '),'-') FROM ticket_record;
SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(ticket_id,'|',user_id,'|',DATE_FORMAT(first_assigned_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f')) ORDER BY ticket_id,user_id SEPARATOR ' ;; '),'-') FROM ticket_participant;

SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(source_ticket_id,'|',target_ticket_id,'|',relation_type,'|',IFNULL(created_by,-1),'|',DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f')) ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' ;; '),'-') FROM ticket_relation;
SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(id,'|',username,'|',status) ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' ;; '),'-') FROM iam_user;
SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(user_id,'|',role_id) ORDER BY user_id,role_id SEPARATOR ' ;; '),'-') FROM iam_user_role;
SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(id,'|',code) ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' ;; '),'-') FROM iam_role;
SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(role_id,'|',permission_id) ORDER BY role_id,permission_id SEPARATOR ' ;; '),'-') FROM iam_role_permission;
SELECT IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(business_date,'=',current_value) ORDER BY business_date SEPARATOR ' ;; '),'-') FROM ticket_daily_sequence;

sql: DELETE r FROM ticket_relation r JOIN ticket t ON t.id = r.source_ticket_id WHERE t.title LIKE 'RL-ACC-20261012-111017-%';
DELETE r FROM ticket_relation r JOIN ticket t ON t.id = r.target_ticket_id WHERE t.title LIKE 'RL-ACC-20261012-111017-%';
DELETE r FROM ticket_record r JOIN ticket t ON t.id = r.ticket_id WHERE t.title LIKE 'RL-ACC-20261012-111017-%';
DELETE p FROM ticket_participant p JOIN ticket t ON t.id = p.ticket_id WHERE t.title LIKE 'RL-ACC-20261012-111017-%';
DELETE FROM ticket WHERE title LIKE 'RL-ACC-20261012-111017-%';
DELETE ur FROM iam_user_role ur JOIN iam_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE u.username = 'rl-acc-20261012-111017-viewer';
DELETE rp FROM iam_role_permission rp JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = rp.role_id WHERE r.code = 'RL_ACC_20261012_111017-VIEWER';
